subject: Taxes
title: Defining a Tax Haven
description: A quick, practical guide to Defining a Tax Haven.

hook.text: A tax haven offers zero or near-zero tax rates, banking secrecy, and minimal regulation.

buildup.text: There's no official list of tax havens. Different organizations use different criteria: secrecy, low rates.

discovery.text: The OECD identifies havens by whether they share tax information.

twist.text: Some of the world's biggest tax havens are US states and European territories—not just tropical islands.

climax.text: Tax havens exist because the world has no single tax authority. Where there are borders, there are loopholes.

punchline.text: Low taxes, high secrecy. Tax havens thrive in the gaps between nations.

quiz.question: What is the key feature of a tax haven?
options: Zero or near-zero rates plus banking secrecy
